test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: The principles of Liberty, Equality and Fraternity were adopted from the Constitution of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The inspiration for Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity was derived from the **French Revolution.**
 
• **The French Revolution took place during 1789-1799.**
 
• The Preamble specifies **Justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity as the objectives.**
 
• The **42nd CAA 1976** added Socialist, Secular, and Integrity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Sources
 Features Borrowed
 
 

 British Constitution
 Single citizenship, Parliamentary government, Rule of Law, legislative procedure, bicameralism, cabinet system, prerogative writs, and parliamentary privileges.
 
 

 US Constitution
 Independence of the judiciary, Fundamental rights, removal of Supreme Court, and high court judges and post of vice president, judicial review, the impeachment of the President.
 
 

 Canadian Constitution
 Vesting of residuary powers in the Centre, Federation with a strong Centre, the appointment of state governors by the Centre and advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court.
 
 

 Weimar Constitution
 Suspension of Fundamental Rights during Emergency.
